headline: Skill balance barely moved. Loot, the Atlas and crafting costs moved a lot.

changes.title: Threads replace Scarabs
changes.body: Ten Thread types (Abyss, Bestiary, Betrayal, Blight, Breach, Expedition, Incursion, Legion, Ritual, Ultimatum), up to 8 per map. These mechanics no longer spawn on their own. Shaped Regions give free Threads, so early juicing is cheaper.

changes.title: Rarity now picks the drop pool
changes.body: High-rarity monsters drop fewer junk scrolls and more valuable currency. Killing rares, uniques and Fate bosses pays more than raw pack clear. Bossing matters more than ever.

changes.title: Tiered ground loot
changes.body: From Act 6, magic and rare items drop with tiers 2-5. Tier 5 can roll +1 item level. Price-check every T4/T5 Simplex Amulet, Cord Belt and fractured base.

changes.title: Atziri moves into the Temple
changes.body: Items can be corrupted a second time. Mortal Fragments become Royal Visages; Sacrifice Fragments now do nothing. Coins become Soul Cores. Vaal Orb recipe needs only 5 Vaal gems.

changes.title: Bench locks cost Divines
changes.body: Lock one prefix or suffix for 1 Divine, two for 2. Lock all costs 4 Divines plus a Sacred Orb (weapons), 4 Blessed (armour) or 8 Exalted (jewellery).

changes.title: Nerfs: Winter Orb, golems, mercenaries
changes.body: Winter Orb: 2 projectiles, 70% effectiveness, about 15% less base damage. Golem buffs cut 20-25%. Mercenaries take -60% resistances in maps and up to 20% less damage.

changes.title: Buffs: Pathfinder, Trickster, Warden, ES
changes.body: Master Distiller gives 30% penetration and +100% crit multi; Heartstopper takes 75% off DoT; five Warden buffs. Malachai's Loop gets more Energy Shield.

changes.title: Rarity farming nerfed
changes.body: Maven's Chisel of Procurement 25% (was 40%), Nightmare and Originator rarity mods down 40-50%, Eldritch Altar rarity lower, quantity altars removed.

market.name: Fracturing Orb
market.why: Fractured items lose most league sources, so demand for making them goes up. Rose 2x in both past leagues.

market.name: Veiled Chaos Orb
market.why: Veiled items only come from Betrayal now. Rose 4.7x and 7.9x by day 14 in past leagues.

market.name: Sacred Orb
market.why: Needed to lock all mods on weapons. Drops more often now, but rose 2-3x in both past leagues.

market.name: Volatile Vaal Orb
market.why: Double corruption is back, so corruption currency gets more use.

market.name: Orb of Chance
market.why: Much rarer, much better at uniques, no longer sold by vendors. A patch bet: it crashed in past leagues.

market.name: Exalted Orb
market.why: 8 per lock-all on jewellery. A patch bet: it fell in past leagues.

market.name: Blessed Orb
market.why: 4 per lock-all on armour. A patch bet: it fell hard in past leagues.

market.name: Vaal Orb
market.why: Recipe now needs 5 Vaal gems instead of 7 plus a Sacrifice Fragment, so more supply.

market.name: Threads (all 10 types)
market.why: Every juiced map needs them. Expect wild prices in the first hours; buy the cheap types of whatever mechanic turns meta.

market.name: Frayed Thread
market.why: New currency: use or vendor for a random Thread. Likely cheap filler.

market.name: Royal Visage
market.why: From Atziri in 81+ Temples; makes Temporal Incursions Alluring. Sell early ones.

market.name: Soul Cores
market.why: Rethemed Coins from Atziri; add a support effect to a gem. New, price unknown.

market.name: Viscera
market.why: Wickerman parts from Fate bosses. Greater and Pinnacle Viscera will be the chase items.

market.name: Scarabs, Orbs of Binding, Mortal Fragments
market.why: Removed or converted. Sacrifice Fragments still exist but do nothing.

builds.name: Cold DoT Occultist
builds.note: 5 mapping, 5 bossing with investment. bLut posted a 3.30 100-div endgame version.

builds.name: Penance Brand Elementalist
builds.note: 5/5 on tier lists. Check the guide for golems (nerfed).

builds.name: Winter Orb Occultist / Elementalist
builds.note: Down to about 3 for bossing after the nerf.
